_comment: VIEWER WIRING (2026-10-18): Crab Umbra's '{2}{U}: Untap enchanted creature' is reachable by a human
through its own line verb `untapact=` (Action::Kind::ActivateUntap). The Umbra enchants a TAPPED
Accomplished Alchemist; three Islands pay {2}{U}. Under human play the activation count folds to 1, so
the line names exactly one plan (accept), and committing it through the viewer's external-chooser path
plays the untap with the summary naming the target.
